newsitem.title: HONG KONG: COSCO HK to buy into Shun Shing - source.
newsitem.headline: COSCO HK to buy into Shun Shing - source.

text.p: COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd, the parent of COSCO Pacific Ltd, plans to buy a 30 percent stake in construction and property development firm Shun Shing Holdings Ltd, a source close to the group said on Monday.
"Shun Shing is clearing with the stock exchange for an announcement to be published on Tuesday," the source said but gave no further details.
Market sources said COSCO will buy the stake through its property arm COSCO (Hong Kong) Property Development Ltd.
Shun Shing, which is 75 percent held by Golden Success Ltd, declined to comment.
Shun Shing shares closed HK$0.02 lower at HK$0.315 on Friday. Trading was suspended on Monday pending an announcement.
